page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top left. Small marginal notes at the left edge, partly cut off. Fragments of marginal notes at the bottom left. The last line, "noctes,", is set on the right, indented under the text.

main_text.p: Quibus legibus derogare aut abrogare conatus fuit Timocrates lege nova à fese rogata, cujus hæc erat sententia: Si quis ærarium sive ex lege, sive ex decreto vinculis est damnatus, aut damnabitur in posterum, ei liceat vades dare pecunia debita certò solvenda, quos vades probaverit populus, atque ita carcere exire: nec liceat præsidibus id recusare: qui si bonâ fide pecuniam solverit, liber fit ipse & vades ejus: si non solverit præfixo tempore, ac vades ejus, ipse in vinculâ[?] retrahatur, vadium verò bona publicentur. Sed an Timocrates legem pertulerit, id est, populo eam probaverit, incertum: mihi.quidem non verosimile. Leges aliæ à Solone latæ, in Timocratea ab oratore recitatæ, quæ juf-ferunt, peculatus convictum, nec tamen capitis damnatum vinculis addici: male tractatorum parentum compertum, ei& nihilominus foro se ingerentem in carcerem conjici ab XI-viris: militiæ deser-torem etiam, si sibi idem jus arrogat, quod cæteri cives habent, quorum salvum caput est, vinciri apud XI-viros: furem, si res furtiva à domino recuperata fuerit, dupli damnari, sin minus, decupli unà cum adjutoribus, unoque cum pede in compede esse per dies quinque totidem noctes,
[?] Note fragments at the bottom left are not readable.

page.notes: Left margin notes are cut off at the edge: the marks "ei", "ivea" and "et" beside the lines are doubtful, and the note beside "& nihilominus" is marked [?]. Bottom-left fragments ("cum", "cmwnz", "hwjad") are cut off or look like handwriting and are not transcribed. "vinculâ" is doubtful. "deser-torem" is doubtful (the line break is hard to read). "mihi.quidem" is printed with a stop. "fese" is printed as such. Long s is plain s throughout. No catchword or signature is visible.
